architectural_scope.reason_attention_is_deferred: No evidence yet shows that the frozen R64 response state fails long-range transport; the proposed flat kernel remains a future one-factor falsification, not an unmeasured architecture change.

artifact_contract.resume_rule: Only continue the same logical run from the newest hash-verified atomic per-update snapshot after process loss; an update is complete only after its snapshot rename commits, so no completed update may be replayed and no seed may change
snapshot_contains: active optimizer state and exact count
cumulative actual sampled and valid-transition counts

causal_hypothesis: A deployable-observation-only recurrent encoder trained to predict the next measured response, followed by a frozen-encoder support controller, can finish a safe 250-tick automatic calibration across the complete configuration envelope and produce a session context for later locomotion conditioning without manual per-build measurements.

frozen_interface.applied_target_observer: fixed P30 for every hidden physical plant

future_frozen_support_gate.cell_derivation: 56 model configurations x 2 actuator plants + 6 nominal-model sensor/transport conditions x 2 actuator plants

heldout_context_gate.actions: the checkpoint's bounded deployable calibrator actions
heldout_context_gate.cells: the existing 16 heldout configurations x 2 hidden plants within the 112 model/plant cells; no additional behavior cells
heldout_context_gate.constant_baseline: predict the frozen Stage-1 training target mean, equivalently zero in normalized target space, on the identical heldout rows
heldout_context_gate.matched_plant_context_rule: for every heldout configuration, start P30 and P31/34 from the same deterministic reset, initial observation, previous action, and h_in with no stochastic sensor perturbation; the deployable calibrator remains authoritative in each closed loop, and final h_out L-infinity separation must exceed 1e-7
heldout_context_gate.normalization: the frozen Stage-1 training normalization only
heldout_context_gate.prediction_metric: mean squared normalized next-response error over all 250 valid transitions using the frozen Stage-1 auxiliary predictor
heldout_context_gate.repeat_rule: repeat every heldout context cell from reset and require all actions, observations, predictions, and h_out values bit-exact
heldout_context_gate.required_prediction_rule: learned aggregate mean MSE must be strictly below the constant baseline separately for P30 and P31/34 at each checkpoint

future_frozen_support_gate.pass_authorizes_only: a separate response-conditioned locomotion-training preregistration; the calibrator checkpoint alone is not a deployable walking policy
future_frozen_support_gate.sensor_noise_seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([120120, 3, checkpoint_index, condition_index, plant_index]); checkpoint order half/final and plant order P30/P31-34

parameter_initialization.log_std_initialization: elementwise log(0.25 * frozen inward action-delta vector)
parameter_initialization.tree_hash_algorithm: for each sorted leaf hash dtype text + compact JSON shape + contiguous raw bytes; canonical-JSON hash the leaf manifest

pass_authorizes_only: one separately frozen full-training implementation/CPU contract; this preregistration does not itself authorize optimizer execution

population.sample_accounting: 20,000 is the maximum scheduled horizon capacity per update; episodes stop on the frozen invalid-support condition, so actual sampled and valid-transition counts must be recorded separately

seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([120120, stage, update_index, environment_index]); environment order is configuration-major then P30/P31-34

stage1.normalization: float64 empirical mean/std from valid auxiliary targets in update 0 only; std=max(std,1e-6); cast once to float32 and freeze
stage1.optimizer_initialization: fresh Adam count 0 with exact-zero m/v for only the seven encoder/auxiliary trainable leaves
stage1.purpose: learn deployable-observation response state by full 250-tick BPTT
required_at_every_update: finite loss, gradients, parameters, Adam moments, and normalization
exact 40x2 population and fixed-P30 observation slot
stage1.rollout: fresh seed-locked ternary exploration at every update through the exact graph absolute/inward rate boundary
stage1.updates: one full-batch gradient and one Adam step per fresh rollout

stage2.frozen_leaves: all Stage-1 encoder and auxiliary leaves
stage2.optimizer_initialization: fresh Adam count 0 with exact-zero m/v for only the two deployable action leaves and three training-only Stage-2 leaves
stage2.purpose: learn a bounded automatic support action with the Stage-1 encoder frozen
required_at_every_update: finite loss, metrics, gradients, parameters, and Adam moments
nonzero valid transition count and exact terminal masking
graph-owned bounds and log-std clamp respected
stage2.reward: 1 per valid support tick, zero after termination, plus 250 only for all 250 valid ticks with final-50-tick unbiased gyro-XY norm <=0.05 rad/s
stage2.stage1_to_stage2_handoff: start from the exact final Stage-1 encoder/auxiliary leaves; retain the seed-60720 exact-zero action head, exact initial training-only log_std, and exact-zero value head; do not carry Stage-1 Adam state

stop_rules: stop before training if the fresh implementation/CPU contract does not pass
stop on source, contract, population, seed, environment, checkpoint, or graph hash drift
stop on nonfinite loss, metric, gradient, parameter, optimizer moment, state, action, observation, or sensor value
stop on zero valid transitions, malformed terminal masking, stale data, failed action commit, or support ambiguity
stop if Stage-1 frozen action leaves or Stage-2 frozen encoder/auxiliary leaves change
stop if any heldout row enters normalization or optimization
stop if graph-owned absolute/inward rate bounds, current/torque safety, or ONNX ABI checks fail
do not retry, tune, extend, choose a closest checkpoint, add attention, or begin locomotion training from a failed result
